events.title: Prokey firmware moved PIN entry fully onto the device
events.description: Prokey announced a firmware update for Prokey Optimum that removed browser-interface PIN entry and required PIN entry directly on the hardware device, alongside token-support updates.

events.title: Guarda Mobile Wallet v3.0.65 upgraded in-app exchange flows
events.description: Guarda announced mobile wallet version 3.0.65 on 2024-04-01, describing a significant update focused on improving the exchange experience inside the wallet.

events.title: OneKey Pro firmware 4.15.0 added SLIP-39 and Attach to PIN
events.description: OneKey Pro system firmware 4.15.0 added SLIP-39 mnemonic support, Attach to PIN passphrase binding, broader transaction parsing, and several security and usability improvements.

events.title: NGRAVE ZERO firmware 1.7 added MetaMask support
events.description: NGRAVE release documentation lists ZERO firmware version 1.7 in October 2024, and its official MetaMask synchronization guide states that MetaMask support was added in firmware 1.7.

events.title: Ronin Wallet began a major security and multi-chain redesign rollout
events.description: Ronin announced a phased wallet update adding stronger security, Ethereum multi-chain support, an in-app browser, token activity history, and expanded NFT details.
